title: XSGD remains actively issued and redeemable
description: Current StraitsX materials continue to describe XSGD as one-to-one SGD-backed, redeemable through verified issuer channels, and supported on current public blockchain routes.
notes: Registry status review based on current official materials.

title: XSGD launches publicly
description: StraitsX, then operating through Xfers, publicly released XSGD on 5 October 2020 with one-to-one Singapore-dollar backing and issuer conversion for verified users.
notes: Official launch announcement and StraitsX fifth-anniversary history agree on the first issuance and public release date.

title: JPYC launches as a regulated issuance and redemption stablecoin
description: JPYC Inc. began the current funds-transfer-service JPYC and JPYC EX issuance and redemption platform on 27 October 2025, with one-to-one Japanese-yen exchange and reserves of deposits and government bonds.
notes: This event distinguishes the current regulated product from the earlier prepaid instrument lineage.

title: GMO Trust begins orderly wind-down of GYEN
description: Effective 15 May 2026, GMO Trust disabled new GYEN purchases and began an orderly wind-down while retaining redemption during the announced Initial Redemption Period.
notes: The record remains winding_down rather than terminated because redemption is still available.

title: BRZ remains actively operated as a Brazilian-real stablecoin
description: Current Transfero materials continue to describe BRZ as a one-to-one BRL-backed stablecoin with reserve custody and redemption through supported regulated partners.
notes: Registry status review; exact group legal-issuer allocation remains unresolved.

title: TRYB remains actively issued and redeemable by BiLira
description: Current BiLira product materials and March 2026 terms continue to provide one-to-one TRY backing, platform issuance, and redemption for eligible users.
notes: Registry status review based on current official terms and audit publications.
